newsitem.title: USA: U.S. coffee roastings lower in latest week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. coffee roastings lower in latest week.

text.p: Complete Coffee Coverage reported U.S. green coffee roastings as follows:
For the week ended January 25, roastings totaled approximately 330,000 60-kg bags, down from 385,000 bags the previous week and compared with 330,000 bags in the corresponding week one year ago.
Cumilative roastings totaled 1,465,000 60-kg bags, versus 1,480,000 bags in the same year ago period. -- New York Commodities Desk +1 212 859 1640
